claim: Patchline ships a calibrated risk frontier separating aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty with coverage gates. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the calibrated risk frontier claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make calibrated-risk-frontier-gate`.
